cap:info.cap:headline: River SAI at Rae-Bareli in Rae-Bareli district of Uttar Pradesh continues to flow in above normal flood situation at 8:00 pm today.
cap:info.cap:description: River SAI at Rae-Bareli in Rae-Bareli district of Uttar Pradesh continues to flow in above normal flood situation at 8:00 pm today. At 8:00 pm, it was flowing at a level of 100.32 m with steady trend which is 0.32 m above its Warning Level of 100 m and 0.68 m below its Danger Level of 101 m.
